description: This file defines API routes for a memory match card game backend, including creating a game, retrieving the deck, and attempting card matches. It uses FastAPI, Pydantic models, and references a service class to manage game logic.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new game, with optional difficulty and seed.

classes.name: CreateGameResponse
classes.description: Response model containing game ID, seed, difficulty, deck size, pair count, move count, and completion status.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Representation of a card with id and value, excluding matched state.

classes.name: MatchRequest
classes.description: Request model containing two card IDs to attempt a match.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Result of a match attempt, indicating whether cards are a pair, remaining pairs, moves, and game completion.

methods.name: CreateGameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest = Body(default=CreateGameRequest()))
methods.description: Creates a new seeded game session with optional difficulty and seed. Returns game metadata.

methods.name: List[Card] get_deck(gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"))
methods.description: Retrieves the current game deck without matched state, identified by game ID.

methods.name: MatchResponse post_match( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"), payload: MatchRequest = Body(...), )
methods.description: Handles a request to match two cards in a game, updating game state and returning match result.
